title: Turn Dead Git Branches Into a Cleanup Script
hook: Run your raw git history through a browser-side intent parser to generate a safe, executable local cleanup script.
waste_source: Unmerged, stale local branches tracked in git for-each-ref
free_ai_mechanism: Browser-native text classification and chronological intent parsing via JavaScript
asymmetry_note: Incumbents charge subscriptions to manage branches centrally; this workflow uses local text-paste compute, bypassing the need for OAuth and cloud sync entirely.
